flashcards.back: Take componentwise maxima with the received vector, then increment the local process component before delivery.
$X<Y$ requires every component of $X$ to be no larger and at least one to be strictly smaller.
If each vector is larger in a different component, neither dominates and the events are concurrent.

homework.prompt: Work a two-process vector-clock trace with one send and one receive.
homework.rubric: Show the vector before send, the piggybacked vector, componentwise max, and post-receive increment.

homework.prompt: $Compare X=(2,1) and Y=(1,2), then explain the result without using lexicographic order.$
homework.rubric: Check every component and name incomparability as concurrency.

codeExercises.starter:
def happens_before(x, y):
    return all(a <= b for a, b in zip(x, y)) and any(a < b for a, b in zip(x, y))
codeExercises.solution: The relation requires all components to be no larger and at least one to be strictly smaller.
